version.value: Orchestral arrangement by Gordon Jacob of the military-band Folk Song Suite of 1923
version.note: The Archive description says this appears to be the only 78-rpm recording of the Jacob orchestration; the Discogs label credit names Jacob as arranger. The Burgess Hill programme note says Jacob made the transcription in 1924 but that it was not published until 1942, so how Barlow’s 1939 orchestra obtained the score is not established here.

performers.note: The orchestra and conductor are credited by both sources. The oboe soloist is named only in the Archive item’s side list.

date.note: Given in the Archive description as December 19, 1939.

place.note: Neither source names the studio or city.

label.value: Columbia Masterworks (United States); English Columbia (United Kingdom)
label.note: Two ten-inch 78-rpm records in each issue.

catalogue.value: Set X-159 (17188-D, 17189-D), March 1940; later MX-159 (17234-D, 17235-D), 1941; English Columbia DB 1930–1931, September 1940
catalogue.note: The Archive description gives the American numbers and issue dates; Discogs catalogues the English pair DB 1930/1931 as 1940.

matrixTakeSides.value: Side 1 CO 25602-2 (first movement); side 2 CO 25603-1 and side 3 CO 25604-1 (Intermezzo, parts 1 and 2); side 4 CO 25605-1 (third movement)
matrixTakeSides.note: Stated in the Archive item’s description; the labels and stampers were not examined for this dossier.

credits.note: The item is filed in that collection; no transfer engineer is named in the description.

date.note: The Archive upload date (22 March 2022) is not a transfer date.

processing.value: FLAC original with a variable-bitrate MP3 derivative, joined from four 78-rpm sides into one file.
processing.note: Equalisation, speed correction and noise reduction are not documented.

digital.format: VBR MP3 derivative of a 78-rpm transfer

composition.value: Vaughan Williams’s copyright in the music runs to the end of 2028 in the UK and EU; Jacob’s arrangement has its own term.
composition.note: The Vaughan Williams Foundation gives 2028 as the year copyright in his music expires. IMSLP marks the suite as not in the public domain in the EU. Composition and arrangement rights are separate from the recording.

recording.value: Territorial EU phonogram public-domain basis: commercial issue in 1940, before 1963
recording.note: The project’s eu-published-before-1963 rule applies to the English Columbia issue of 1940 and the American set of March 1940: the former 50-year phonogram term had expired before the 2013 extension. This is not United States or worldwide clearance and not a Creative Commons licence.
